cases.complaint: My broadband router loses internet on every device. I am frustrated. I restarted the router and it still does not work.
My mobile data cannot connect although I can still make calls. I am unhappy with this problem.
Our landline has no dial tone. I am frustrated because fixed voice service is unavailable.
Our IPTV live broadcast buffers and freezes. I am disappointed with the television service.
I am happy: the mobile data service works again after the support team helped.
Something is wrong, but I have not identified the service or symptoms yet.
